posts.text: Do the California primaries election results show a “red wave” in California? The answer is no. The fact that there are more counties that’s leaned Republican than counties that leaned Democrat doesn’t mean anything, if those counties have low population.  Let’s fact check @𝐋𝐞𝐱𝐢 and her claim.
